'''Bel Zana''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Je'daii Ranger]] who served the [[Je'daii Order]] on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] at the height of the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire's]] reign. She was known for her tracking skills.
